name: Tenteko Onsen Jidaigeki ~Kameya~
original_name: てんてこ温泉時代劇 ～亀屋～
source:
Kenta is the third son who runs a shop in Edo. One day his parents become owners of a bankrupt hot-spring ryokan "Kameya" and insist that Kenta assists them here. Kenta only agrees to leave Edo on condition that he would return if can successfully restore the ryokan in a year's time. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
健太是在江户经营店铺的一户人家的三儿子。某天，父母买下一家已经破产、名叫“龟屋”的温泉旅馆，坚持要健太前来帮忙。健太答应离开江户，但提出一个条件：若能在一年内成功令旅馆恢复经营，他便要返回江户。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
